To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The participants in this study expressed a desire for surrogates that would allow them to quickly scan video segments, and that would support their ability to recognize the gist of video objects.
The fast forward video surrogate is the preferred surrogate among video users, and the participants' understanding of video gist includes three components: topical, story, and visual.

(1) users are able to effectively perform video tasks using a fast forward video surrogate, (2) users prefer fast forward surrogates over other surrogates tested, and (3) users prefer surrogates with audio to surrogates with text.
